temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn. When Carolyn asks if something is wrong, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging, so her recent quietness is unusual and may mean something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns Marilyn is indeed struggling with work and personal stress, though Marilyn does not share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues and appreciates Carolyn's concern, but may not be ready to discuss specifics.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and keep the door open for Marilyn to talk without pushing too hard.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and says she hopes she did not overstep, Marilyn apologizes and says it has just been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed and had acknowledged Carolyn's support, but Carolyn does not yet understand why Marilyn seemed curt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's apology and explanation suggest her curtness was due to a hard week rather than Carolyn overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's support and was reacting to her own stress, not necessarily to Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and slightly hurt, then relieved and empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear up misunderstandings and continue offering non-intrusive support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responds positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn accepts warmly and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful that her friendship with Marilyn is developing, and she believes Marilyn has been receptive to her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's enthusiastic acceptance strengthens Carolyn's belief that the friendship is growing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in socializing outside work and values the connection with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the gathering and strengthen the personal friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At work, Marilyn still seems to maintain professional distance. When Carolyn raises their work dynamic, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they are building a friendly relationship outside work, but she perceives Marilyn as keeping distance at the bank, which disappoints and confuses her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's response suggests the distance may be unintentional or resolvable, and Marilyn is willing to discuss it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn may not have intended the professional distance and is open to improving their work collaboration, though the issue is not yet fully resolved.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed, then cautiously relieved and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Have a private conversation to improve their work dynamic and collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal. Marilyn agrees, says she is glad they talked, and says she looks forward to working more closely with Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's agreement and enthusiasm confirm the improved understanding and willingness to partner.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is stronger, and Marilyn is willing and eager to collaborate closely.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up on the project proposal and further their partnership.
